caption: Schematic calculation chain. Building inputs and model parameters enter persistent paceval graphs; host-side orchestration and independent verification complete the workflow.

One-step temperature residuals for both revision formulas against the same deterministic synthetic observations.

Analytical derivative of the version-2 baseline squared-residual score with respect to the envelope conductance UA.
Minimum squared-residual score by thermal capacitance on the executed grid, separately optimizing other grid parameters for each model version.
